title: Mitsuru and Yukari by the river

cues.text: A Kyoto riverbank path. Yukari walks ahead of Mitsuru.
Mitsuru holds her cheek; Yukari turns away.
Yukari walks off. Mitsuru stays, a sweat drop on her brow.
Mitsuru's Persona Penthesilea appears, an armored woman with blade arms. It becomes Artemisia, a masked woman with spiked wings.
Flecks sink into Mitsuru's chest. She stands still, then smiles.
